items.title: Ripple Borrows $275 Million at 8.25% to Take On Goldman Sachs. Can It Win?
items.summary: Ripple just borrowed $275 million to chase businesses that Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley have dominated for decades. Whether that bet makes sense depends on a tension buried inside its own credit rating.

items.title: The Dow Loses Steam. Goldman and Caterpillar Strike Again.
items.summary: Unlikely AI stocks are dragging down the Dow for a second day in a row. Goldman Sachs and Caterpillar were the bottom two stocks in the blue-chip index. Together, they shaved off about 300 points from the Dow.

items.title: Goldman's McClure Says IPO Market 'Wide Open' for Business
items.summary: Matthew McClure, Goldman Sachs global co-head of investment, says the IPO market is "open for business," with AI-related companies accounting for more than half of capital raised despite representing about 20% of IPOs this year. Speaking with Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals," McClure says confidence is growing in private equity, with $1.5 trillion of capital waiting to be deployed.

items.title: Goldman's LCN Deal Extends Its Push to Scale AWM & Durable Revenues
items.summary: GS's LCN deal expands its AWM platform into private real estate, supporting recurring fees and a more capital-light revenue mix.
